basis: ESTIMATE from the maker's description (black-dyed Cake Batter ice cream, mixed with Halloween OREO, KIT KAT, M&M'S or sprinkles) and a ranking of the standard Cake Batter base. Cake Batter is buttery-vanilla cake aroma and very sweet; no sourness, little salt, smooth and dense texture. Mix-ins add cocoa and cookie crunch. Colour is dye, so no flavour difference from standard Cake Batter.

Based on one firsthand tasting (Sporked, 13 April 2026, 8.5/10) plus Graeter's description: French Pot bourbon-kissed base with black cherries and praline pecans, no chocolate. Reviewer found plump fruity cherries, very crunchy sweet praline chunks, a faintly boozy note but little real bourbon flavour, and a base that tasted of banana. Scores are my estimate from those notes: warm caramel-bourbon-cherry aroma, light bitterness from dark fruit and nut skins, sweet but not cloying, slight tannin from cherry and pecan, mild alcohol warmth. Little salt; mild fruit tartness; dense creamy texture.

reviews.title: I Tried Graeter's New Kentucky Derby Bourbon Ice Cream
reviews.quote: I couldn't get much actual bourbon flavor. ... The cherries are plump and fruity.

basis: ESTIMATE from Peters' description (butter, caramel and toffee flavours with Anzac biscuit pieces, caramel swirl, more biscuit on top, wafer cone with choccy tip) and Peters' marketing head calling it 'buttery, sweet, packed with biscuit pieces'. Banana-confectionery aroma, very sweet, mild cocoa bitterness from choc biscuits and coating, no meaningful sourness, little salt; soft biscuits, chewy-crisp texture.

No sourness expected.

LOW-CONFIDENCE ESTIMATE. Re-score per flavour once flavours are known.
